metadata.note: All figures in million THB as returned. Rong Kwang trail resolves the 79M record: FY2564 budget line = 79.0 = exactly 20% of the 395M multi-year commitment. | RRD S-band timeline derived from filtered queries (fiscal_year+agency+LIKE).

reconciliation_notes: 79M mystery RESOLVED: the 79M record is the FY2564 single-year budget line of the 395M multi-year Rong Kwang commitment (395 x 20% = 79.0 exactly); not a separate contract.
GFMIS multi-year budget lines for Rong Kwang sum to 399.505M (79+158+157.295+5.21) vs the 394.295M contract — small in-year adjustments.
Total GFMIS-disbursed across FY2564-67: ~380.35M of the 394.295M contract.

RRD-08's report figure '177,432,750 first installment FY2565' does not match GFMIS FY2565 (157.577M) or cumulative-through-2565 (216.72M) — the report figure needs its own reconciliation; recorded, not overridden.

rrd_sband_procurement_timeline.note: NO budget line through FY2568 — consistent with FY2570 request; the plan's 235M upgrade never materialised as a budget line

tmd_sathing_phra_trail.note: year-1 line; TMD-09 records 20.865M advance against the 139.1M contract signed 17 Jul 2567
